description: This file appears to be a shell script used for testing notes merging functionality in a Git repository. It contains shell commands, functions for verifying notes and fanout configurations, and a series of test cases that set up repositories, perform merges, and check outcomes related to Git notes, including conflict scenarios.

methods.name: verify_notes
methods.description: Verifies that the notes for a given reference match expected values, by comparing against expected files and the output of 'git notes' command.

methods.name: verify_fanout
methods.description: Checks if the notes tree under a specific reference has a fanout of 1, meaning all note paths conform to a specific structure.

methods.name: verify_no_fanout
methods.description: Checks if the notes tree under a specific reference has no fanout, ensuring that no paths match the fanout pattern.
